SpriteInAir.name: Koopa-type sprite in the air: behaviour
summary: Shared tail for sprites 0-13 (Koopas, shells, para-Koopas) that are not on the ground. Animates if the sprite has flutter wings
(bit 7 of Spr0to13Prop), turns around at a ledge if it stays-on-ledges (bit 1) and then handles Mario and sprite interaction.
Falls into Spr0to13Gfx after flipping direction when touching an object.

Spr0to13Gfx.name: Draw Koopa-type sprite (sprites 0-13)
summary: Graphics routine for sprites 0-13. Shows the turning image while the turn timer [$15AC,X] is set (direction is flipped
temporarily for the first 3 frames of the turn). Draws a 1-tile or 2-tile high sprite according to bit 6 of Spr0to13Prop and
adds wings for sprite numbers >= 8. Quirk: the 2-tile path subtracts $0F or $10 from Y depending on the animation frame (SBC with the
carry from LSR [$1602,X]).

DoneWithSprite.name: Restore sprite direction and return
summary: Pops the direction saved by Spr0to13Gfx back into [RAM_SpriteDir,X].

SpinyEgg.name: Spiny egg main routine
summary: Sprite thrown by Lakitu. Falls with reduced gravity; when it lands it turns into a Spiny (sprite $13), re-initialises its tables
and faces Mario. Only runs while sprites are not locked and status is 8 (normal).

GreenParaKoopa.name: Green para-Koopa main routine (flying and bouncing)
summary: Sprites 8 (flying, bobbing up and down with no gravity) and 9 (bouncing along the ground). Sets X speed from the direction table,
stops against walls, hops on landing and then draws via Spr0to13Gfx. Also the shared draw/return stub at CODE_018CB7 used by the red para-Koopas.

s018CBA.name: Table: red para-Koopa speed step and limit
summary: Two tables: speed increment per direction ($FF/$01) at $018CBA and the speed limit ($F0/$10) at $018CBC.

RedHorzParaKoopa.name: Red horizontal para-Koopa: entry
summary: Uses horizontal offscreen handling (SubOffscreen1) then joins RedVertParaKoopa.

RedVertParaKoopa.name: Red para-Koopa main routine
summary: Sprite $0A moves vertically only, the other (horizontal) moves sideways while bobbing up and down. Every 4 frames the speed is changed by
+/-1 until it reaches $F0 or $10, then the sprite pauses for $30 frames and reverses. Starts the turning timer when the direction changes.

WingedGoomba.name: Winged Goomba main routine
summary: Walks in the facing direction at speed 8 and hops: three small hops (Y speed $F0) then one big hop (Y speed $D0) followed by a random
wait of $50-$8F frames. Wings flap faster while rising; they stop flapping while it waits on the ground. Counter [$151C,X] counts the small hops.

s018DC7.name: Table: winged Goomba wing X offsets
summary: 16 X offsets: 2 wings per frame, 4 frames, for the left-facing case; the second 8 for right-facing.

s018DD7.name: Table: winged Goomba wing Y offsets
summary: 8 Y offsets: 2 wings per frame for 4 frames.

GoombaWingGfxRt.name: Draw Goomba wings
summary: Draws the two wing tiles (spaced 8 OAM slots apart so the body fits between) for the animation frame in [$1570,X]/[$1602,X].
Frames 0-1 use 16x16 tile $C6, frames 2-3 use 8x8 tile $5D. The right wing is X-flipped. Priority bits come from [$64].

SetAnimationFrame.name: Advance two-frame animation
summary: Increments the animation counter [$1570,X] and sets [$1602,X] = bit 3 of it, so the image toggles every 8 frames.

PiranhaSpeed.name: Table: Piranha plant Y speeds per state

PiranTimeInState.name: Table: Piranha plant time per state

ClassicPiranhas.name: Piranha plant main routine
summary: Handles the normal and upside-down (sprite $2A) pipe Piranha plants. Draws the plant (behind objects unless eaten by Yoshi) and
recolours the stem tile. State [$C2,X] & 3: 0 hidden, 1 rising, 2 up, 3 retracting. Moves with PiranhaSpeed while the timer [$1540,X]
runs, else goes to ChangePiranhaState. [$1594,X] set = Mario nearby: plant stays hidden and is not drawn or interacted with.

ChangePiranhaState.name: Piranha plant: next state
summary: State 0: stay hidden while Mario is within $1B pixels horizontally of the plant (sets [$1594,X] = 1). Otherwise clears that flag,
loads the state timer from PiranTimeInState and advances to the next state.

HoppingFlame.name: Hopping flame main routine
summary: Sprite that hops on the ground and spits a flame. Contains the helper at $018EEF (find a free extended sprite slot, Y = slot) and
the jump/spawn helper at $018F50. After landing a random timer of $20-$3F runs; when it reaches 1 the flame jumps (Y speed $D0-$DF)
and creates extended sprite 3 (hopping flame's flame) if on screen.

Lakitu.name: Lakitu graphics and interaction
summary: Draws Lakitu (image 2 while the throw timer [$1558,X] runs, with the second tile raised by 3 pixels). If [$151C,X] is set calls the
bank 2 routine CODE_02E672 (probably the cloud/Lakitu follow routine). Falls into SubSprSpr+MarioSpr.

SubSprSpr+MarioSpr.name: Interact with sprites and Mario
summary: Calls SubSprSprInteract then jumps to MarioSprInteractRt.

BulletGfxProp.name: Tables: Bullet Bill properties per direction
summary: Indexed by direction [$C2,X] 0-7: 0 right, 1 left, 2 up, 3 down, 4 up-right, 5 down-right, 6 down-left, 7 up-left.
BulletGfxProp = OAM property (palette/flip), DATA_018FCF = animation frame.

BulletBill.name: Bullet Bill main routine
summary: Sets direction = 1, then (unless sprites are locked) sets palette, frame and X/Y speed from the direction in [$C2,X], moves with no gravity,
interacts with blocks and with Mario/sprites. Kills the sprite when it leaves the screen vertically. While [$1540,X] is set it uses the
graphics routine at CODE_019546 (purpose not traced, probably a death/explosion state).

timerCODE_019001.name: Bullet Bill: set speeds and move
summary: Middle of BulletBill (label created by a stray comment): stores X and Y speed, moves, interacts, offscreen-kills, draws.

s01902E.name: Table: terminal Y speed per medium
summary: $40 in air, $10 in water.

SubUpdateSprPos.name: Update sprite position with gravity
summary: Moves the sprite in Y, applies gravity to Y speed, then moves it in X and does block interaction (CODE_019140).
Medium is chosen by the water flag [$164A,X]: air gravity +3, terminal speed $40; water gravity +1, terminal speed $10, upward speed limited
to $E8 and X speed scaled to 3/4 for the move. If [$15DC,X] is set the sprite ignores objects (object status cleared).

FlipIfTouchingObj.name: Turn around if touching object
summary: Flips the sprite if it is touching an object in the direction it is facing (bit 0 for right, bit 1 for left in [RAM_SprObjStatus,X]).

FlipSpriteDir.name: Flip sprite direction
summary: Unless the turn timer [$15AC,X] is running: sets it to 8, negates the X speed and toggles [RAM_SpriteDir,X].

GenericSprGfxRt2.name: Long-call generic sprite graphics
summary: Sets the data bank to the program bank ($01) and runs SubSprGfx2Entry1; returns long (RTL).

SpriteObjClippingX.name: Table: sprite-object clipping X offsets
summary: Probably 4 bytes per clipping index: X offsets of the sprite's right side, left side and the centre points used for floor/ceiling
checks (exact roles not traced). Each row below is two indices.
